# Aidan Hill
Berkeley City Council, District 7
## For Southside. For Berkeley. For All of Us.
Keep Southside affordable.
Protect public land.
Make growth accountable.
Meet Aidan
Join the Team
## Aidan’s Platform
## Keep Southside Affordable
More housing should come with tenant protections, preservation, and permanently affordable homes.
## Protect Public Land
Parks, clean sidewalks, public restrooms, trees, and gathering spaces are basic civic infrastructure.
## Modernize City Services
UC, developers, and City Hall should help fund the services, safety, transit, and maintenance growth requires.
Read the Platform
Newsletter Block
This newsletter signup form needs a storage option. Edit the block and enter a storage location via the Storage tab.
## Experience rooted in service
Public service, direct service, and Mutual Aid in Southside, Berkeley, and across the East Bay.
### Public Service
Former Berkeley Homeless Commission Vice Chair and Vice President, People’s Park Council.
### Direct Service
Medical case manager in a nonprofit community health setting, helping people navigate care, benefits, housing needs, and support services.
### Mutual Aid and Preparedness
Longtime East Bay Food Not Bombs and People’s Park advocate, and Alameda County Fire Department CERT Program graduate.
Frequently Asked Questions
Aidan's Voting Record
## Endorsements
Aidan is endorsed by the Peace and Freedom Party of California and received a shared endorsement from FLIP Berkeley City Council.
Individual endorsers include former Berkeley City Councilmember Cheryl Davila, Dr. Kerby Lynch, Glenn Turner, Andrea Prichett, Elana Auerbach, Paul Kealoha-Blake, former Planning Commissioner Clifford Fred, and environmental advocate Elizabeth Starr.
Endorse Aidan

# Endorse Aidan Hill
## Join the Coalition Supporting Aidan Hill
for Berkeley City Council District 7
Endorse Aidan Hill and help build a coalition of students, workers, healthcare professionals, residents, small businesses, and community leaders committed to a more affordable, livable, and accountable Southside.
Submit Your Endorsement
## A Growing Coalition for Southside
Support is growing from organizations, community leaders, student workers, and residents who want a more affordable, livable, and accountable Southside.
Organizations Supporting Aidan
## Peace and Freedom Party
## Forward Party of California
## Flip Berkeley City Council
## Civic Leaders
### Cheryl Davila
#### Former Berkeley City Councilmember
### Robin D. López
#### Albany City Councilmember
### Paul Kealoha Blake
#### Homeless Services Panel of Experts Commisioner
### Steve Martinot
#### Former Planning Commissioner
### Gary Blenner
#### Former Trustee, Center Joint Unified School District
### Auntie Frances Moore
#### Founder, Self Help Hunger Program
## Community Voices
### Student Workers
“As a healthcare worker, I support Aidan because they understand that healthy communities require stable housing, accessible public spaces, and responsive local government.”
Sam Gomez, Student Worker
“I support Aidan because they lead with care, accountability, and a commitment to the people most affected by decisions made in Berkeley.”
Emily Flores, Student Worker
### Residents
“I support Aidan Hill for Berkeley City Council because they are an important changemaker and a facilitator of relevant conversations. Aidan’s pragmatic vision offers younger generations hope and a voice in local government. They are truly listening to the people of Berkeley, and our family is proud to support their campaign.”
“I support Aidan because they are a champion for Berkeley and committed to making sure residents have a voice in the future of our community.”
Nikki Powell, Berkeley Resident
“Aidan Hill got me into doing regular volunteering for Food Not Bombs when People’s Park was still with us. They were watering the trees and plants there and taking people on tours of People’s Park’s nature. Three years running now for me volunteering with Food Not Bombs, and it’s been better, more together, and more rewarding than my paying jobs.”
Will Martin, Berkeley Resident

## Add Your Name to the Coalition
Southside deserves representation rooted in the people who live here. Join a growing coalition of organizations, community leaders, student workers, and residents supporting Aidan Hill for District 7.
If you support housing stability, public accountability, protected public space, and a stronger voice for residents in District 7, I invite you to add your endorsement.
The form takes about 2–3 minutes to complete.
